CODELEARN · F6 — LEARN PAGE, MARK COMPLETE & PROGRESS

FER202 final assignment (mini LMS) · Function 6 of 11 · Starter = reference of F5 · Suggested time: 150 minutes · Total: 10 marks

1. Overview

The heart of an LMS. /learn/:courseId sends the student to the lesson to resume (the first lesson, in course order, that is not completed yet); /learn/:courseId/lessons/:lessonId shows one lesson: the YouTube video, the notes, a sidebar with every chapter/lesson (✓ when done), Previous / Next, and a button that marks the lesson complete or incomplete. Progress is the completedLessons array of the student's enrolment — saved on the server, so it survives a reload and shows on My Courses.

API calls

WhenRequest
open the pagecourse + curriculum (F4 thunk) and my enrolments (F5 thunk)
mark complete / incompletePATCH /enrollments/:id { completedLessons: [1, 2, 3, 4] } — a NEW array, sorted, no duplicates
My Courses %lesson totals for the enrolled courses: GET /lessons?courseId=1&courseId=3

YouTube

db.json stores watch links (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SqcY0GlETPk, sometimes https://youtu.be/…). YouTube refuses to show those inside an <iframe>; the iframe needs https://www.youtube.com/embed/SqcY0GlETPk. Write toEmbedUrl(url); an unknown link ⇒ #no-video.

Edge cases

  • Not enrolled ⇒ #not-enrolled (typing the URL must not open the lesson); guest ⇒ /login.
  • A lesson id from another course ⇒ #lesson-not-found.
  • All lessons done ⇒ resume at the first lesson and show #course-complete.
  • Previous disabled on the first lesson, Next disabled on the last — across chapters.

Main features

  • Access & resume · Lesson view · Mark complete (PATCH) · Progress on My Courses · Structure

General requirements

  • Continue from your own F5 code (or the starter, which is the F5 reference). Files marked NEW/EDIT in the tree are the ones this step touches.
  • Create React App (React 18), React Router v6, Redux Toolkit, Axios, React-Bootstrap; json-server 0.17.4 on port 9999 (1.x dropped _expand/_embed).
  • Every HTTP call goes through src/api/*.js (one axiosClient with baseURL: process.env.REACT_APP_API_URL); each API function returns response.data itself — do not rely on interceptors (the auto-grader’s axios does not run them).
  • Keep the ids/classes printed in the brief — the auto-grader uses them. Components never call axios directly.

4. Data model

db.json — 8 collections (json-server 0.17.4, port 9999)

FieldTypeNotes

5. Functional requirements

1. Access & resume 2 marks

Requirements:

  • Protected routes /learn/:courseId and /learn/:courseId/lessons/:lessonId. Not enrolled ⇒ #not-enrolled. No lesson id ⇒ <Navigate replace> to the first unfinished lesson (all done ⇒ first lesson). Foreign lesson id ⇒ #lesson-not-found.

Must use: useParams Navigate

Example:

an@codelearn.vn (done 1, 2, 3) opens /learn/1 ⇒ /learn/1/lessons/4

2. Lesson view 2.5 marks

Requirements:

  • #lesson-title, #lesson-position "Lesson N of M", iframe#lesson-video with the embed URL, #lesson-content; sidebar #lesson-list with every lesson as .lesson-link (class done + "✓" when completed, active for the current one); #prev-lesson / #next-lesson across chapters, disabled at the ends.

Must use: useMemo (flat lesson list)

3. Mark complete (PATCH) 3 marks

Requirements:

  • #mark-complete toggles: "Mark as complete" ⇄ "Mark as incomplete"; thunk toggleLessonComplete PATCHes a new sorted array; #progress-text "D/T lessons completed (P%)" and #progress-bar (React-Bootstrap ProgressBar, label "P%") update; 100% ⇒ #course-complete.

Must use: createAsyncThunk PATCH ProgressBar

4. Progress on My Courses 1.5 marks

Requirements:

  • Each .my-course card shows .my-course-progress (ProgressBar, label "P%") from completedLessons and the course lesson total; P = round(done / total × 100), 0 when the course has no lessons.

5. Structure 1 mark

Requirements:

  • Pure helpers in utils/learning.js: toEmbedUrl, calcProgress, resumeLesson; API in enrollApi.updateProgress.

6. Element ids / classes used by the auto-grader

SelectorPurpose
#learn-course-title #progress-bar #progress-text #lesson-list .lesson-link#lesson-link-ID (.done .active)sidebar
#lesson-position #lesson-title #lesson-video #no-video #lesson-contentlesson
#prev-lesson #mark-complete #next-lesson #course-completeactions
#not-enrolled #lesson-not-found #no-contentguards / empty
.my-course-progressprogress on My Courses

7. Grading rubric

#FeatureMarks
1Access & resume2
2Lesson view2.5
3Mark complete (PATCH)3
4Progress on My Courses1.5
5Structure1
Total10

Common deductions

  • completedLessons.push(id) on Redux state then PUT the whole enrolment (sends the expanded course back into db.json).
  • Progress kept only in React state or localStorage — wrong on another browser and lost on My Courses.
  • Hard-coded http://localhost:9999 in components instead of the .env variable.
  • Mutating Redux/React state, or writing localStorage inside a reducer.
  • App crashes (white screen) on an empty list, an unknown id or a server error.

8. Submission

Work in the editor (files on the right) or download the starter, then npm install and npm run dev (json-server :9999 + React :3000) and paste your files back. Press Run for the sample checks and Submit for full grading (hidden checks included). The reference solution of this step unlocks after an Accepted submission.

1. Tổng quan

Trái tim của một LMS. /learn/:courseId đưa học viên tới bài học tiếp (bài đầu tiên, theo thứ tự khoá, chưa hoàn thành); /learn/:courseId/lessons/:lessonId hiện một bài: video YouTube, nội dung, thanh bên có mọi chương/bài (✓ khi đã xong), Trước / Sau, và nút đánh dấu hoàn thành / chưa hoàn thành. Tiến độ là mảng completedLessons trong lượt ghi danh của học viên — lưu trên máy chủ nên tải lại trang vẫn còn và hiện ở My Courses.

Lời gọi API

Khi nàoRequest

YouTube

db.json lưu link xem (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SqcY0GlETPk, đôi khi https://youtu.be/…). YouTube từ chối hiện link đó trong <iframe>; iframe cần https://www.youtube.com/embed/SqcY0GlETPk. Viết toEmbedUrl(url); link lạ ⇒ #no-video.

  • Chưa ghi danh ⇒ #not-enrolled (gõ thẳng URL cũng không mở được bài); khách ⇒ /login.
  • Id bài của khoá khác ⇒ #lesson-not-found.
  • Đã xong hết ⇒ học tiếp từ bài đầu và hiện #course-complete.
  • Nút Trước khoá ở bài đầu, Sau khoá ở bài cuối — tính xuyên chương.
